verses: Taa Seen Meem
Yeh aayaten hain roshan kitab ki
Hum aap kay samney Musa aur Firaun ka sahih waqiah biyan kertay hain unn logon kay liye jo eman rakhtay hain

Yaqeenan Firaun ney zamin mein sirkashi ker rakhi thi aur o haan kay logon ko giroh giroh bana rakha tha aur unn mein say aik firqay ko kamzor ker rakha tha aur unn kay larkon ko to zibah ker dalta tha aur unn ki larkiyon ko zindah chor deta tha. Be-shak o shuba)yeh woh tha hi mufisdon mein say
Phir humari chahat hui kay hum unn per karam farmaeen jinhen zamin mein hadd kamzor ker diya gaya tha, aur hum unhen ko paishwa aur (zamin) ka waris banayen
Aur yeh bhi kay hum unhen zamin mein qudrat o ikhtiyar den aur Firaun aur Haman aur unn kay lashkaron ko woh dikhayen jiss say woh darr rahey hain

Hum ney Musa (alaihi as-salam) ki maa ko wahee ki kay ussay doodh pilati reh aur jab tujhay uss ki nisbat koi khof maloom ho to ussay darya mein baha dena aur koi darr khof ya ranj ghum na kerna, hum yaqeenan ussay teri taraf lotaney walay hain aur ussay apney payghumbaron mein bananey walay hain

Aakhir Firaun kay logon ney uss bachay ko utha liya kay aakhir-kaar yehi bacha unn ka dushman hua aur unn kay ranj ka baees bana, kuch shak nahi kay Firaun aur Haman aur unn kay lashkar thay hi khata kaar

Aur Firaun ki biwi ney kaha yeh to meri aur teri aankhon ki thandak hai, ussay qatal na kero, boht mumkin hai kay yeh humen koi faeedah phonchaye ya hum ussay apna hi beta bana len aur yeh log shaoor hi na rakhtay thay

Musa (alaihi as-salam) ki walida ka dil bey qarar hogaya, qareeb thin kay uss waqiah ko bilkul zahir ker detin agar hum unn kay dil ko dharas na dey detay yeh uss liye kay woh yaqeen kerney walon mein rahey
Musa (alaihi as-salam) ki walida ney uss ki behan say kaha kay to uss kay peechay peechay jaa, to woh ussay door hi door say dekhti rahi aur firaoniyon ko uss ka ilm bhi na hua

Unn kay phonchney say pehlay hum ney Musa (alaihi as-salam) per daeeiyon ka doodh haram ker diya tha. Yeh kehney lagi kay kiya mein tumhen aisa gharana bataon jo uss bacha ki tumharay liye perwerish keray aur hun bhi woh uss bachay kay khair khuwah
Pus hum ney ussay uss ki maa ki taraf wapis phonchaya, takay uss ki aankhen thandi rahen aur aazardah khatir na ho aur jaan ley kay Allah Taalaa ka wada sacha hai lekin aksar log nahi jantay
Aur jab Musa (alaihi as-salam) apni jawani ko phonch gaye aur pooray tawana hogaye hum ney unhen hikmat o ilm ata farmaya, neki kerney walon ko hum ussi tarah badla diya kertay hain

Aur Musa (alaihi as-salam) aik aisay waqt shehar mein aaye jabkay shehar kay log ghaflat mein thay. Yahan do shakhson ko lartay huye paya, yeh aik to uss kay rafiqon mein say tha aur yeh doosra uss kay dushmanon mein say, uss ki qom walay ney uss kay khilaf jo uss kay dushmanon mein say tha uss say faryad ki, jiss per Musa (alaihi as-salam) ney uss ko mukka maara jiss say woh marr gaya Musa (alaihi as-salam) kehney lagay yeh to shetani kaam hai, yaqeenan shetan dushman aur khulay tor per behkaney wala hai
Phir dua kerney lagay kay aey perwerdigar! mein ney khud apney upper zulm kiya, to mujhay moaf farma dey, Allah Taalaa ney ussay bakhsh diya, woh bakhsish aur boht meharbani kerney wala hai
Kehney lagay aey meray rab! jaisay tu ney mujh per yeh karam farmaya mein bhi abb hergiz kissi gunehgar ka madadgar na bano ga

Subha hi subha dartay andesha ki halat mein khabren lenay ko shehar mein gaye, kay achanak o hi shakhs jiss ney kul unn say madad talab ki thi unn say faryad ker raha hai. Musa (alaihi as-salam) ney uss say kaha kay uss mein shak nahi to to sareeh bey raah hai

Phir jab apney aur uss kay dushman ko pakarna chaha woh faryadi kehney laga kay Musa (alaihi as-salam) kiya jiss tarah tu ney kul aik shakhs ko qatal kiya hai mujhay bhi maar daalna chahata hai, to to mulk mein zalim o sirkash hona hi chahata hai aur tera yeh iradah hi nahi kay milaap kerney walon mein say ho
Shehar kay parli kinaray say aik shakhs dorta hua aaya aur kehney laga aey Musa! yahan kay sardar teray qatal ka mashwara ker rahey hain, pus to boht jald chala jaa mujhay apna khair khuwah maan
Pus Musa (alaihi as-salam) o haan say khofzada hoker dekhtay bhaltay nikal kharay huye, kehney lagay aey perwerdigar! mujhay zalimon kay giroh say bacha ley
Aur jab madiyan ki taraf mutawajha huye to kehney lagay mujhay umeed hai kay mera rab mujhay seedhi raah ley chalay ga

Madiyan kay pani per jab aap phonchay to dekha kay logon ki aik jamat o haan pani pila rahi hai aur do aurten alag khari apney (janwaron ko) rokti hui dikhaee den, poocha kay tumhara kiya haal hai, woh boleen kay jab tak yeh charwahey wapis na lot jayen hum pani nahi pilatin aur humaray walid boht bari umar kay boorhay hain
Pus aap ney khud unn janwaron ko pani pila diya phir saye ki taraf hatt aaye aur kehney lagay aey perwerdigar! to jo kuch bhalaee meri taraf utaray mein uss ka mohtaj hun

Itney mein unn dono aurton mein say aik unn ki taraf sharm o haya say chalti hui aaee, kehney lagi kay meray baap aap ko bula rahey hain takay aap ney humaray (janwaron) ko jo pani pilaya hai uss ki ujrat den, jab hazrat Musa (alaihi as-salam) unn kay pass phonchay aur unn say apna sara haal biyan kiya to woh kehney lagay abb na darr tu ney zalim qom say nijat paee
Unn dono mein say aik ney kaha kay abba ji! aap unhen mazdoori per rakh lijiye, kyunkay jinhen aap ujrat per rakhen unn mein say sab say behtar woh hai jo mazboot aur amanat daar ho

Uss buzurg ney kaha mein apni unn dono larkiyon mein say aik ko aap kay nikkah mein dena chahata hun uss (mehar per) kay aap aath saal tak mera kaam kaaj keren. Haan agar aap das saal pooray keren to yeh aap ki taraf say bator ehsan kay hai mein yeh hergiz nahi chahata kay aap ko kissi mushaqqat mein dalon, Allah ko manzoor hai to aagay chal ker aap mujhay bhala aadmi payen gay

Musa (alaihi as-salam) ney kaha, khair to yeh baat meray aur aap kay darmiyan pukhta hogaee, mein unn dono muddaton mein say jissay poora keroon mujh per koi ziyadti na ho, hum yeh jo kuch keh rahey hain uss per Allah (gawah aur) kaarsaaz hai

Jab hazrat Musa alaihi as-salam ney muddat poori kerli aur apney ghar walon ko ley ker chalay to koh tor ki taraf aag dekhi. Apni biwi say kehney lagay thehro! mein ney aag dekhi hai boht mumkin hai kay mein o haan say koi khabar laon ya aag ka koi angara laon takay tum seenk lo
Pus jab o haan phonchay to uss ba-barkat zamin kay maidan kay dayen kinaray kay darakht mein say awaz diye gaye kay aey Musa! yaqeenan mein hi Allah hun saray jahano ka perwerdigar

Aur yeh (bhi awaz aaee) kay apni laathi daal dey. Phir jab ussay dekha kay woh saanp ki tarah phan phana rahi hai to peeth pher ker wapis hogaye aur murr ker rukh bhi na kiya, hum ney kaha aey Musa! aagay aa darr mat, yaqeenan to her tarah aman wala hai

Apney hath ko apney girbaan mein daal woh baghair kissi qasam kay rog kay chamakta hua niklay ga bilkul safaid aur khof say (bachney kay liye) apney bazoo apni taraf mila ley, pus yeh dono moajzzay teray liye teray rab ki taraf say hain Firaun aur uss ki jamat ki taraf, yaqeenan woh sab kay sab hukum aur nafarman log hain
Musa (alaihi as-salam) ney kaha perwerdigar! mein ney unn ka aik aadmi qatal ker diya tha. Abb mujhay andesha hai kay woh mujhay bhi qatal ker dalen

Aur mera bhai Haroon (alaihi as-salam) mujh say boht ziyadah faseeh zaban wala hai to ussay bhi mera madadgar bana ker meray sath bhej kay woh mujhay sacha manay, mujhay to khof hai kay woh sab mujhay jhutla den gay

Allah Taalaa ney farmaya kay hum teray bhai kay sath tera bazoo mazboot ker den gay aur tum dono ko ghalba den gay fiaroni tum tak phonch hi na saken gay, ba-sabab humari nishaniyon kay, tum dono aur tumhari tabeydaari kerney walay hi ghalib rahen gay

Pus jab unn kay pass Musa (alaihi as-salam) humaray diye huye khulay moajzzay ley ker phonchay to woh kehney lagay yeh to sirf ghara gharaya jadoo hai hum ney apney aglay baap dadon kay zamaney mein kabhi yeh nahi suna

Hazrat Musa (alaihi as-salam) kehney lagay mera rab Taalaa ussay khoob janta hai jo uss kay pass ki hidayat ley ker aata hai aur jiss kay liye aakhirat ka (acha) anjam hota hai. Yaqeenan bey insafon ka bhala na hoga

Firaun kehney laga aey darbariyo! mein to apney siwa kissi ko tumhara mabood nahi janta. Sunn aey Haman! to meray liye mitti ko aag say pakwa phir meray liye aik mehal tameer ker to mein Musa kay mabood ko jhank loon ussay mein to jhooton mein say hi guman ker raha hun
Uss ney aur uss kay lashkaron ney na-haq tareeqay per mulk mein takabbur kiya aur samajh liya kay woh humari janib lotaye hi na jayen gay
Bil-aakhir hum ney ussay aur uss kay lashkaron ko pakar liya aur darya burd ker diya, abb dekh ley kay unn gunehgaron ka anjam kaisa kuch hua?
Aur hum ney unhen aisay imam bana diye kay logon ko jahannum ki taraf bulayen aur roz qayamat mutlaq madad na kiye jayen
Aur hum ney uss duniya mein bhi unn kay peechay apni laanat laga di aur qayamat kay din bhi woh bad-haal logon mein say hun gay

Aur unn aglay zamaney walon ko halak kerney kay baad hum ney Musa (alaihi as-salam) ko aisi kitab inayat farmaee jo logon kay liye daleel aur hidayat o rehmat hoker aaee thi takay woh naseehat hasil kerlen
Aur tor kay maghribi janib jab kay hum ney Musa (alaihi as-salam) ko hukum ehkaam ki wahee phonchaee thi, na to to mojood tha aur na to dekhney walon mein say tha

Lekin hum ney boht si naslen peda kin jin per lambi muddaten guzar gaeen, aur na to madiyan kay rehney walon mein say tha kay unn kay samney humari aayaton ki tilawat kerta balkay)yeh hum hi rasoolon kay bhejney walay rahey

Aur na to tor ki taraf tha jab kay hum ney awaz di balkay)yeh yeh teray perwerdigar ki taraf say aik rehmat hai, uss liye kay to unn logon ko hoshiyaar ker dey jin kay pass tujh say pehlay koi daraney wala nahi phoncha, kiya ajab kay woh naseehat hasil kerlen

Agar yeh baat na hoti kay unhen unn kay apney hathon aagay bhejay huye aemaal ki wajah say koi museebat phonchti to yeh keh uthtay kay aey humaray rab! tu ney humari taraf koi rasool kiyon na bheja? Kay hum teri aayaton ki tabeydaari kertay aur eman walon mein say ho jatay

Phir jab unn kay pass humari taraf say haq phoncha to kehtay hain kay yeh woh kiyon nahi diya gaya jaisay diye gaye thay Musa (alaihi as-salam) acha to kiya Musa (alaihi as-salam) ko jo kuch diya gaya tha uss kay sath logon ney kufur nahi kiya tha, saaf kaha tha kay yeh dono jadoogar hain jo aik doosray kay madadgar hain aur hum to unn sab kay munkir hain
Keh dey kay agar sachay ho to tum bhi Allah kay pass say koi aisi kitab ley aao jo unn dono say ziyadah hidayat wali ho mein ussi ki pairwee keroon ga

Phir agar yeh teri na manen to to yaqeen kerley kay yeh sirf apni khuwahish ki pairwee ker rahey hain. Aur uss say barh ker behka hua kaun hai? Jo apni khuwahish kay peechay para hua ho baghair Allah ki rehnumaee kay, be-shak Allah Taalaa zalim logon ko hidayat nahi deta
Aur hum barabar pay darpay logon kay liye apna kalaam bhejtay rahey takay woh naseehat hasil kerlen
Jiss ko hum ney uss say pehlay kitab inayat farmaee woh to uss per bhi eman rakhtay hain
Aur jab uss ki aayaten unn kay pass parhi jati hain to woh keh detay hain kay uss kay humaray rab ki taraf say haq honey per humara eman hai hum to uss say pehlay hi musalman hain
Yeh apney kiye huye sabar kay badlay dohra dohra ajar diye jayen gay. Yeh neki say badi ko taal detay hain aur hum ney jo unhen dey rakha hai uss mein say detay rehtay hain

Aur jab byhoda baat kaan mein parti hai to uss say kinara ker letay hain aur keh detay hain kay humaray amal humaray liye aur tumharay aemaal tumharay liye, tum per salam ho, hum jahilon say (ulajhna) nahi chahatay
Aap jissay chahayen hidayat nahi ker saktay balkay)yeh Allah Taalaa hi jissay chahaye hidayat kerta hai. Hidayat walon say o hi khoob aagah hai

Kehney lagay agar hum aap kay sath hoker hidayat kay tabey daar bann jayen to hum to apney mulk say uchak liye jayen, kiya hum ney unhen aman mein aur hurmat walay haram mein jagah nahi di? Jahan tamam cheezon kay phal khinchay chalay aatay hain jo humaray pass bator rizq kay hain, lekin unn mein say aksar kuch nahi jantay

Aur hum ney boht si woh bastiyan tabah ker den jo apni aish o aish-o-ishrat mein itraney lagi thin, yeh hain unn ki rehaeesh ki jagahen jo unn kay baad boht hi kum abad ki gaeen aur hum hi hain aakhir sab kuch kay waris

Tera rab kissi aik basti ko bhi uss waqt tak halak nahi kerta jab tak kay unn ki kissi bari basti mein apna koi payghumbar na bhej dey jo unhen humari aayaten parh ker suna dey aur hum bastiyon ko ussi waqt halak kertay hain jab kay o haan walay zulm o sitam per kamar kiss len
Aur tumhen jo kuch diya gaya hai woh sirf zindagi duniya ka saman aur ussi ki ronaq hai, haan Allah kay pass jo hai woh boht hi behtar aur dairpaa hai. Kiya tum nahi samajhtay

Kiya woh shakhs jiss say hum ney nek wada kiya hai jissay woh qata’an paney wala hai misil uss shakhs kay hosakta hai? Jissay hum ney zindagani duniya ki kuch yunhi si manfa’at dey di phir bil-aakhir woh qayamat kay roz pakra bandha hazir kiya jaye ga
Aur jiss din Allah Taalaa unhen pukar ker farmaye ga kay tum jinhen apney guman mein mera shareek thehra rahey thay kahan hain

Jin per baat chuki woh jawab den gay kay aey humaray perwerdigar! yehi woh hain jinhen hum ney behka rakha tha, hum ney unhen ussi tarah behkaya jiss tarah hum behkay thay, hum teri sarkar mein apni dast bardari kertay hain, yeh humari ibadat nahi kertay thay
Kaha jaye ga kay apney shareekon ko bulao, woh bulayen gay lekin unhen woh jawab tak na den gay aur sab azab dekh len gay, kaash yeh log hidayat paa letay
Uss din unhen bula ker poochay ga kay tum ney nabiyon ko kiya jawab diya?
Phir to uss din unn ki tamam daleelen gumm ho jayen gi aur aik doosray say sawal tak na keren gay
Haan jo shakhs tauba kerley eman ley aaye aur nek kaam keray yaqeen hai kay woh nijat paney walon mein say ho jaye ga

Aur aap ka rab jo chahata hai peda kerta hai aur jissay chahata hai chun leta hai, unn mein say kissi ko koi ikhtiyar nahi, Allah hi kay liye paki hai woh buland tar hai her uss cheez say kay log shareek kertay hain
Unn kay seenay jo kuch chupatay aur jo kuch zahir kertay hain aap ka rab sab kuch janta hai
O hi Allah hai uss kay siwa koi laeeq ibadat nahi, duniya aur aakhirat mein ussi ki tareef hai. Ussi kay liye farman-rawaee hai aur ussi ki taraf tum sab pheray jao gay
Keh dijiye! kay dekho to sahi agar Allah Taalaa tum per raat hi raat qayamat tak barabar ker dey to siwaye Allah kay kaun mabood hai jo tumharay pass din ki roshni laye? Kiya tum suntay nahi ho?

Poochiye! kay yeh bhi bata do kay agar Allah Taalaa tum per hamesha qayamat tak din hi din rakhay to bhi siwaye Allah Taalaa kay koi mabood hai jo tumharay pass raat ley aaye? Jiss mein tum aaram hasil kero, kiya tum dekh nahi rahey ho?
Ussi ney to tumharay liye apney fazal o karam say din raat muqarrar ker diye hain kay tum raat mein aaram kero aur din mein uss ki bheji hui rozi talash kero, yeh uss liye kay tum shukar ada kero
Aur jiss din unhen pukar ker Allah Taalaa farmaye ga kay jinhen tum meray shareek khayal kertay thay woh kahan hain?

Aur hum her ummat mein say aik gawah alag kerlen gay kay apni daleelen paish kero pus uss waqt jaan len gay kay haq Allah Taalaa ki taraf hai, aur jo kuch iftra woh jortay thay sab unn kay pass say kho jaye ga

Qaroon tha to qom Musa say, lekin unn per zulm kerney laga tha hum ney ussay (uss qadar) khazaney dey rakhay thay kay kaee kaee taqat war log ba mushkil uss ki kunjiyan utha saktay thay, aik baar uss ki qom ney uss say kaha kay itra mat! Allah Taalaa itraney walon say mohabbat nahi rakhta

Aur jo kuch Allah Taalaa ney tujhay dey rakha hai uss mein say aakhirat kay ghar ki talash bhi rakh aur apney dunyawi hissay ko bhi na bhool aur jaisay kay Allah ney teray sath ehsan kiya hai to bhi acha salook ker aur mulk mein fasad ka khuwan na ho, yaqeen maan kay Allah mufisdon ko pasand rakhta hai

Qaroon ney kaha yeh sab kuch mujhay meri apni samajh ki bana per hi diya gaya hai, kiya ussay abb tak yeh nahi maloom kay Allah Taalaa ney uss say pehlay boht say basti walon ko ghaarat ker diya jo uss say boht ziyadah qooat walay aur boht bari jama poonji walay thay. Aur gunehgaron say unn kay gunahon ki baaz purs aisay waqt nahi ki jati

Pus Qaroon poori aaraeesh kay sath apni qom kay majmay mein nikla, to dunyawi zindagi kay matwalay kehney lagay kaash kay humen bhi kissi tarah woh mill jata jo Qaroon ko diya gaya hai. Yeh to bara hi qismat ka dhani hai

Zee ilm log unhen samjhaney lagay kay afsos! behtar cheez to woh hai jo bator sawab unhen milay gi jo Allah per eman layen aur nek amal keren yeh baat unhi kay dil mein daali jati hai jo sabar o sahara walay hun
(aakhir-kaar) hum ney ussay uss kay mehal samet zamin mein dhansa diya aur Allah kay siwa koi jamat uss ki madad kay liye tayyar na hui na woh khud apney bachaney walon mein say ho saka

Aur jo log kul uss kay martaba per phonchney ki aarzoo mandiyan ker rahey thay woh aaj kehney lagay kay kiya tum nahi dekhtay kay Allah Taalaa hi apney bandon mein say jiss kay liye chahaye rozi kushadah ker deta hai aur tang bhi? Agar Allah Taalaa hum per fazal na kerta to humen bhi dhansa deta, kiya dekhtay nahi ho kay na-shukron ko kabhi kaamyabi nahi hoti?

Aakhirat ka yeh bhala ghar hum unn hi kay liye muqarrar ker detay hain jo zamin mein unchaee baraee aur fakhar nahi kertay na fasad ki chahat rakhtay hain. Perhezgaron kay liye nihayat hi umdah anjam hai
Jo shakhs neki laye ga ussay uss say behtar milay ga aur jo buraee ley ker aaye ga to aisay bad-aemaali kerney walon ko unn kay unhi aemaal ka badla diya jaye ga jo woh kertay thay

Jiss Allah ney aap per Quran nazil farmaya hai woh aap ko doobara pehli jagah laney wala hai, keh dijiye! kay mera rab ussay bhi bakhoobi janta hai jo hidayat laya hai aur ussay bhi jo khulli gumrahi mein hai
Aap ko to kabhi uss ka khayal bhi na guzra tha kay aap ki taraf kitab nazil farmaee jaye gi lekin yeh aap kay rab ki meharbani say itra. Abb aap ko hergiz kafiron ka madadgar na hona chahaye

Khayal rakhiye kay yeh kuffaar aap ko Allah Taalaa ki aayaton ki tableegh say rok na den uss kay baad kay yeh aap ki janib utari gaeen, to apney rab ki taraf bulatay rahen aur shirk kerney walon mein say na hun

Allah Taalaa kay sath kissi aur mabood ko na pukarna ba-juz Allah Taalaa kay koi aur mabood nahi, her cheez fana honey wali hai magar ussi ka mun (aur zaat). Ussi kay liye farman-rawaee hai aur tum ussi ki taraf lotaye jao gay
